value.rationale: A natural singular-spectrum benchmark for matrix-free inverse-trace estimation: the star has vanishing outlier mass but an order-one contribution to the first Krylov moment. The theorem shows exact finite-sample bias sign and scale separation between one and two Lanczos nodes, including the unavoidable constant chi-square noise floor, useful for algorithmic evaluation beyond merely recomputing a spectrum.
